THEINVENTOR-SCRAP.description: At the end of combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards to remove from your deck. Obtain its [gold]Gadget[/gold].
THEINVENTOR-SCRAP.title: Scrap
THEINVENTOR-TEMPORARY_GADGET.description: A [gold]Gadget[/gold] that lasts until the end of combat. Does not require scrapping an additional card.
THEINVENTOR-TEMPORARY_GADGET.title: Temporary Gadget
THEINVENTOR-GADGET.description: Gadgets are items that passively provide you with powerful abilities, but are destroyed after a period of time.
THEINVENTOR-GADGET.title: Gadget
